artifact_policy.base: Native R4 is the immutable dependency/toolchain/vendor/wheelhouse substrate.
per_node_delta: build flags, CPU-feature policy, focused receipts
base R4 identity and deterministic base-plus-delta restore script

required_controls: frozen candidate and baseline commit, wheel, comparator, corpus, and configuration
CPU model/topology/SMT, governor, turbo/frequency, thermal and throttling metadata
candidate-owned cgroup CPU/PSI, task-clock, cycles, instructions, cache misses, context switches, migrations
randomized balanced AB/BA pairs, warmup policy, contamination rejection fixed before candidate visibility
median paired log ratio, robust dispersion, bootstrap confidence interval and sample count
one tuning-excluded holdout revealed only after candidate freeze
benchmark_contract.external_cpu_independence: No shared-host method makes wall-clock performance literally independent of external CPU use. Use trusted dedicated bare metal for absolute claims; otherwise report controlled paired or exploratory evidence only.
benchmark_contract.speedup_gate: Publish only when the preregistered candidate/baseline confidence-interval upper ratio is below the declared threshold and correctness receipt is PASS.

rust_first_execution.default_target: Rust owns supported production numerical computation; Python owns configuration, validation, orchestration, explicit oracle selection, result wrapping, plotting, and user-facing I/O.
rust_first_execution.parallelism: Serial inside small dependent trajectories; deterministic coarse parallelism across independent trajectories, rays, modes, or batches using one owned pool.
rust_first_execution.vectorization: Use contiguous SoA/batched layouts, loop fusion, cached coefficients, no post-warm allocation, compiler vectorization first, then runtime-dispatched std::arch kernels with forced-scalar fallback. No fast-math authority path.
rust_first_execution.ffi: Coarse plan/run/result calls, GIL released for Rust-only work, no per-step Python callbacks, explicit counters for calls, copies, allocations, and workers.
rust_first_execution.gpu: Optional only after CPU RF-04/RF-05 closure; framework lane before custom CUDA; f64 and transfer-inclusive evidence; CPU remains required authority.
